title: Discussing Noise with a Neighbor
context: Nina 和 Sam 住在不同公寓。最近几晚 Sam 的电视声音影响 Nina 入睡，两人在门口商量安静安排。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Sam, could we talk about the TV sound from your apartment?
dialogue.zh: Sam，我们能谈谈你公寓里的电视声音吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Sure, Nina. Has it been bothering you?
dialogue.zh: 当然，Nina。它一直在打扰你吗？

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Yes. I have heard it late for the past few nights, and I cannot fall asleep.
dialogue.zh: 是的。过去几个晚上我深夜都听得到，睡不着。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: I am sorry. I did not realize you could hear it through the wall.
dialogue.zh: 对不起。我不知道你隔着墙也能听见。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Could you lower it after ten at night?
dialogue.zh: 晚上十点后你能把声音调低吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: I can. Would a low volume after ten work for you?
dialogue.zh: 可以。十点后开小声一点，对你可以吗？

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Yes, that would help. I usually go to bed around then.
dialogue.zh: 可以，那会有帮助。我通常那时候睡觉。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: I will also move the TV away from our shared wall.
dialogue.zh: 我还会把电视移离我们共用的墙。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Thank you. May I let you know if I can still hear it?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。如果我还是听得到，可以告诉你吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Please do. You can knock on my door the next day.
dialogue.zh: 请告诉我。你可以第二天来敲我的门。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: That sounds good. I appreciate you talking about it.
dialogue.zh: 好。谢谢你愿意商量这件事。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Of course. I hope tonight is quieter.
dialogue.zh: 当然。希望今晚能安静一些。

expressions.zh: 打扰你，用于询问对方是否受到影响。
expressions.example: Has the noise been bothering you?

expressions.zh: 入睡，强调进入睡眠的过程。
expressions.example: I cannot fall asleep with the TV on.

expressions.zh: 把声音调低，可用于电视或音乐。
expressions.example: Could you turn it down after ten?

expressions.zh: 较低的音量，用来描述声音大小。
expressions.example: A low volume would help me sleep.

expressions.zh: 告诉你情况，适合约定后续反馈。
expressions.example: I will let you know if I still hear it.

pronunciation: volume 的重音在第一音节 /ˈvɑːljuːm/；asleep 的重音在第二音节 /əˈsliːp/。练习 lower it，连贯说出两个词。

practice.title: Part 1 · Quiet places
practice.prompt: When do you like to have a quiet place?
practice.answer: I like a quiet place in the evening, especially when I am getting ready for bed. It helps me relax.

practice.title: Part 2 · A neighbor
practice.prompt: Describe a conversation with a neighbor about a shared concern. Explain the concern and what happened.
practice.answer: A neighbor and I once talked about a bright light outside our doors. It shone into my room at night, so I explained the problem politely. My neighbor had not noticed it and offered to change its direction. We agreed to see if that helped for a few days. Afterward I thanked her because my room was much darker and I could sleep more comfortably. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Living near others
practice.prompt: How can neighbors discuss a problem calmly?
practice.answer: They can describe its effect and ask for a specific change. Listening and agreeing on a way to follow up can also help.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先听完整对话，再逐句跟读，再完成口头练习。
practice.answer: 用四到六句描述持续的声音和影响，提出具体时间，并约定如何再次沟通。
